column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_html_view.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point: registers the scene with system_scene_register(0x34 start = system_html_view_scene_main, 0x84 end = system_html_view_scene_end, 0x5620) and returns 0. Side effects: scene slot callbacks. No direct caller (ELF entry point of scene 0x0e).

Scene start callback: sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000), system_html_view_init, then calls system_html_view_step once per frame (system_wait_frame between calls) until it returns non-zero, and returns to the calling scene with system_scene_return(0xe, 0). No return value. Side effects: network/HTTP set-up and teardown, the HTML viewer utility, scene change. No direct caller (registered as the scene start callback by system_html_view_register_scene).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. No direct caller (registered as the scene end callback).

Loads the network utility modules in order with sceUtilityLoadModule: 0x100, 0x102, 0x103, 0x104, 0x105, 0x106 (net common, inet, parse URI, parse HTTP, HTTP, SSL); on the first failure unloads them all (system_html_view_unload_net_modules). Returns the last sceUtilityLoadModule result (negative on failure). Side effects: utility modules loaded. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_init_network).

Unloads the network utility modules in reverse order with sceUtilityUnloadModule: 0x106, 0x105, 0x104, 0x103, 0x102, 0x100. No return value. Side effects: utility modules unloaded. Callers: 2 (system_html_view_load_net_modules, system_html_view_term_network).

Initialises the HTTP stack: sceSslInit(0x28000), sceHttpInit(0x28000), sceHttpsInit(0, 0, 0, 0), sceHttpsLoadDefaultCert(0, 0), sceHttpLoadSystemCookie(); after a failure of any call but the first it shuts the stack down again (system_html_view_term_http). Returns the last result (negative on failure). Side effects: SSL/HTTP library state. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_init_network).

Saves the system cookies (sceHttpSaveSystemCookie) and ends HTTPS, HTTP and SSL (sceHttpsEnd, sceHttpEnd, sceSslEnd). No return value. Side effects: cookie file, library state. Callers: 2 (system_html_view_init_http, system_html_view_term_network).

Brings the network up for the viewer: loads the net utility modules, sceNetInit(0x20000, 0x2a, 0, 0x2a, 0), sceNetInetInit, sceNetResolverInit, sceNetApctlInit(0x5400, 0x30) (arguments as decompiled; the first is a relocated constant) and the HTTP stack (system_html_view_init_http); any failure after sceNetInit tears everything down (system_html_view_term_network). Returns the last result (negative on failure). Side effects: modules and network libraries. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_step).

Tears the network down: system_html_view_term_http, sceNetApctlTerm, sceNetResolverTerm, sceNetInetTerm, sceNetTerm, then unloads the net utility modules. No return value. Side effects: network libraries, modules. Callers: 2 (system_html_view_step, system_html_view_init_network).

Maps the game language (save_get_language: 0 j, 1 e, 2 g, 3 f, 4 i, 5 s) to the value stored in the viewer parameters: 0 -> 0, 1 -> 1, 2 -> 6, 3 -> 2, 4 -> 5, 5 -> 3, anything else 1. Note that BOOT.BIN's save_init_dialog_common maps 2 (German) to 4; here it becomes 6 (hypothesis: a game bug or a different enum, confidence low). Returns the mapped value. No side effects. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_start_viewer).

Appends the fixed start URL (the string at 0x55cc, a konami.jp address for the game) to buffer with system_strcat. No return value. Side effects: writes buffer. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_start_viewer, buffer 0x56e8).

Writes "/PSP/SAVEDATA/" followed by the game's save directory name (save_build_save_dir_name) into buffer: the viewer's download directory, so downloads land in the game's own save folder. No return value. Side effects: writes buffer. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_start_viewer, buffer 0x58e8).

Fills the 0xa8-byte HTML viewer parameter block at 0x5630 (field names per the PSPSDK SceUtilityHtmlViewerParam layout, confidence medium): +0 size 0xa8, +4 language (system_html_view_get_language), +8 button swap (1 unless the confirm button is circle 0x2000), thread priorities +0xc 0x11, +0x10 0x13, +0x14 0x12, +0x18 0x10; +0x30 memory, +0x34 memory size 0x600000; +0x40 initial URL 0x56e8 (system_html_view_append_url); +0x44 3 tabs; +0x48 interface mode 2; +0x4c options 0x2ba; +0x50 download directory 0x58e8 (system_html_view_build_download_dir); download/upload names 0; +0x60 cookie mode 3; +0x64 0x200; +0x68 home URL = the initial URL; +0x6c, +0x70, +0x74 = 1; +0x78 = 0; +0xa4 = 1; then calls sceUtilityHtmlViewerInitStart(0x5630). Returns that result (negative on failure; the decompiler hides it, confidence medium). Side effects: parameter block, URL buffers, utility started. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_step).

One frame of the HTML viewer utility: sceGuSync(0, 0), then by sceUtilityHtmlViewerGetStatus: 2 (visible) sceUtilityHtmlViewerUpdate, 3 (quit requested) sceUtilityHtmlViewerShutdownStart, 0 (finished) returns 1 when the result word +0x1c of the parameter block (0x564c) is 0, else 2. Returns 0 while running. Side effects: utility state. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_step).

Sets the step word 0x562c to 1 and the viewer memory pointer 0x596c to 0x5970 (a buffer inside the module image). No return value. Side effects: those two words. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_scene_main).

Step machine on 0x562c: 1 brings the network up (system_html_view_init_network) and starts the viewer with the memory 0x596c, going to 2, or to 3 on any failure; 2 updates the viewer until it finishes, then 3; 3 tears the network down, then 4; 4 returns 1. Returns 0 in the other steps. Side effects: network, utility, step word. Callers: 1 (system_html_view_scene_main).
